components.name: Primary Button (nav)
components.description: Persistent pill CTA in the sticky nav; links to the pinned hero message.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #176D5D; color: #F4F1EA; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 8px 16px; font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.875rem; transition: background 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #0F4F44; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0F4F44; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: On-Teal Button
components.description: CTA nested inside a pinned (teal) bubble; reads as punched through the surface.
components.css: .ds-btn-on-teal { background: #F4F1EA; color: #0F4F44; border: none; border-radius: 12px; padding: 10px 16px; width: 100%; font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.875rem; transition: transform 0.15s; } .ds-btn-on-teal:hover { transform: scale(1.02); } .ds-btn-on-teal:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-on-teal:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #F4F1EA; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Incoming Chat Bubble
components.description: The system's signature primitive — a received message with a speech-tail corner and optional timestamp.
components.css: .ds-bubble-incoming { background: #FFFFFF; color: #241C15; border-radius: 16px 16px 16px 4px; padding: 12px 16px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; line-height: 1.6; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(36,28,21,0.06), 0 8px 20px -14px rgba(36,28,21,0.35); max-width: 88%; width: fit-content; } .ds-bubble-time { display: block; text-align: right; margin-top: 4px; font-size: 0.7rem; color: rgba(90,80,68,0.6); }

components.name: Pinned Bubble
components.description: The system's namesake component — a pinned, teal-filled message holding the primary CTA.
components.html:
Pesan disematkan

Daftar sekarang, misi pertama nunggu kamu.
components.css: .ds-bubble-pinned { background: #176D5D; color: #F4F1EA; border-radius: 16px 16px 16px 4px; padding: 14px 16px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(15,79,68,0.4), 0 14px 28px -16px rgba(15,79,68,0.7); max-width: 92%; width: fit-content; } .ds-pinned-label { display: block; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; color: rgba(220,237,232,0.8); margin-bottom: 6px; }

components.name: Sticky Navigation
components.description: Translucent paper header with the wordmark and single pill CTA.

narrative.overview: Rebahancuan renders its offer the way a trusted opportunity actually reaches someone in Indonesia: as a message in a chat thread, not a landing-page pitch. The system borrows WhatsApp/Telegram's own grammar — bubbles, forwarded tags, read ticks, a pinned banner — and runs it through a warm, paper-toned palette so it reads as a real conversation on a real device, never as a UI kit demo. One color, deep teal, carries the thread's momentum (the assistant's voice, the primary action, the verified state); a single amber accent is reserved for the one mark that is actually the brand — the coffee icon tying back to the Secangkir Cerita blog — so it stays legible as a signature, not wallpaper. The system explicitly rejects the "aplikasi penghasil uang" template: no neon gradients, no countdown timers, no fake join-counters. Density stays conversational — one idea per bubble, generous vertical rhythm between sections — because a wall of marketing copy would break the thread illusion the whole system depends on.
keyCharacteristics: Chat-native structure: bubbles, forwarded tags, pinned banners, and timestamps as real UI grammar, not decoration
One committed accent (teal) for action and verification; amber reserved for the brand mark only
Warm paper ground throughout — no dark mode variant; the scene is a daytime phone-in-hand read
System-native font for bubble text (mimics how a real chat app renders), a distinct display face for headings

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Teal is the only saturated color allowed to carry a fill, button, or link. Amber never spreads beyond the coffee mark; a second saturated color loose on the page collapses the "trusted single sender" read the whole system depends on.

rules.name: The No-Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: No small-caps, letter-tracked label ever sits above a heading or section title. Section identity comes from the heading and an inline icon, never from a kicker.

rules.name: The Tinted Shadow Rule
rules.body: A shadow under a colored surface is always tinted from that surface's own hue, never generic black/gray.

dos: Do keep teal as the only saturated color carrying a fill, button, or active state.
Do reserve Coffee Amber (#B9752D) for the coffee-mark brand icon only.
Do render bubble/message text in the system-ui chat stack, and every heading/structural label in Manrope.
Do tint every shadow from the surface color it sits under.
Do label any illustrative/example data explicitly rather than presenting it as real.
donts: Don't add a kicker, eyebrow, or uppercase-tracked label above any heading or section title.
Don't introduce a second saturated accent color.
Don't use emoji as functional UI icons — icons are drawn SVG in the system's single stroke weight.
Don't use a hard-edged, zero-blur block shadow anywhere.
Don't invent member counts, countdowns, or testimonials to manufacture urgency.
